title: Van-style fuel cap for van, bus and rig
why: Use the actual first blue van as the common hardware reference, adding readable detail across the vehicle family.
author: Codex art analyst
acceptance: User requested tickets and a visual result for details on all cars, using the first car as reference. First car means the blue van, the first TIERS entry in vehicles.py. Use its actual existing sprite and the proposal folder as visual inputs; these are review proposals, not claims that production art is already changed.
An8x8 round fuel filler cap with a readable recessed dark center and stepped rim on the existing gray tank. Keep the neighboring tank straps visible.

Emit exactly one standalone atlas sprite decal_vehicle_fuel_cap at8x8 native pixels,fully opaque with only the listed palette colors. The embedded pixel_art legend/rows specify the exact native draft, making the ticket reproducible without access to local preview files. Target RGBA SHA256 81450a24809ed13f738e6ccbe717c5addb996a4da68b27ccc54ea659f68d9c63.

Bake this sprite at EVERY placements entry in parent-local pixels, also into the matching ext_ sprite at the same coordinates. All sprites are unrotated at1x.
